summary: The cutover runbook composes every ruled ordering constraint and covers V01–V22's runbook-side content. Its state surgery, no-destroy plan, registry entries, sync checks and prd expected diff hold against the code, the live estate and a render-vs-render comparison of both stages. Four advisory findings remain, none blocking.

findings.summary: The Conventions say only the no-destroy plan touches OpenBao-held credentials, but the pre-flight dumps the stage's eight ESO Secrets to /tmp/live.json and names no keystroke owner
P2's hand-written release-<m> tag command omits the seven image references its own prose and the job's message require
X1 expects helm list to print nothing; Helm 4.3 prints its header row on an empty namespace
P3 leaves /work/KubeCoderDeploy detached at origin/prd; P6/P7's git pull --ff-only then fails
